scope: Read-only KGM consumer-policy, historical-cohort, and mappings-only dependency audit before new MIM source/export comparison.
findings_disposition: No new current-code defect established by this bounded static audit. Candidate-specific compatibility and scientific conflicts remain unassessed until exact archive/export evidence is available. Existing safeguards are acceptance requirements, not permission to relabel historical evidence.

conditions: Only supported/unified mapping artifacts change; all other selected inputs, shared code and policies remain unchanged and fresh.
Freshness must be evaluated on the final checkout and actual native receipts. Old merge inputs and receipts remain immutable.
mapping_only_closure.all_producer_expansion: kg_microbe/utils changes and shared curation listed in transform_fingerprint.py:43-84 invalidate shared identities for all canonical producers. In particular ingredient identity/name/context/recipe policy changes are not mapping-only.
mapping_only_closure.metatraits_dynamic_binding: metatraits.py:275-285 discovers canonical TSVs; metatraits_gtdb.py:85-87 inherits those and parent package code. The special table is a direct runtime path despite exclusion from candidate reconstruction.

required_consumer_checks.name: historical_55
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: Replay exact 17+38 source-trait cohort through both real special/manual resolver paths and retain current-code/candidate identities. Current table has 203 rows; historical 194 is not its present denominator. Five historical targets are now correctly local: angustmycin, rubradirin, rhodomycin A, pluramycin A, racemomycin E. Preserve these reviewed corrections; do not restore original reconciled IDs from the historical ledger.

required_consumer_checks.name: potato
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: Bare Potato must not acquire cas:93348-51-7 extract identity. Preserve full native occurrence and candidate claims, independent valid selections, nonbare positive controls, mapping/native-input binding, repeated finalization and public admission.

required_consumer_checks.name: oatmeal_substrate_and_nested_solutions
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: Keep exact native oatmeal/substrate finite holds before unified/legacy/embedded lookup; explicit nested solution IDs own identity. Preserve occurrence order/count/typed quantity/metadata and all four audit files, including honest zero cohorts; reject new or contradictory native context.

required_consumer_checks.name: catalase
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: NCIT:C61062 human CAT native metadata/activity authority is not a generic catalase ingredient identity. Preserve eight reviewed native observations and historical candidate evidence; deny reintroduction through supported/unified/native reconstruction, legacy and embedded routes, while retaining native positive assay controls.

required_consumer_checks.name: hydrate_and_cas
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: Hydrates require native label/scope and correctly directed native part-to-base evidence; weak recipe closeMatch is not identity. Validate CAS shape/checksum before every name/formula/category/parent/hydrate/xref carrier route, including CAS-RN and embedded routes. Preserve rejected full rows and local occurrence context, never repair chemistry by normalization.

required_consumer_checks.name: identity_connected_quarantine_and_aliases
required_consumer_checks.acceptance: Trace historical nonlexical exactMatch, reversed/shared identifiers and invalid-CAS contamination; include native same_as and admitted independent/supported identities before reconstruction. Native xrefs do not expand scope or establish exact identity. Preserve complete original rows and multiplicity. Reconstruct per-claim alias/source attribution; do not copy entity-wide provenance. Explicitly compare every candidate object_label/other alias because current builder adds both to lexical indexes.

required_artifacts: Exact old/new source archive, source SSSOM, review, owner records, export code/lock/workflow identities; separate review of scientific changes before export/implementation.

Native supported/withheld/disposition manifest and complete-row partition; schema/recipe/Python 3.13/workflow compatibility review. Current KGM contract requires manifest schema 1, fixed three product filenames and eleven disposition columns; never substitute digests into mismatched assumptions.

Candidate report with before/after input fingerprints, supported and unified byte hashes, full quarantine with row multiplicity, per-claim alias suppression/withdrawal/owner/form/registry delta, and independently reviewed candidate acceptance.
Second-cycle ordered semantic and byte stability; exact 55-row runtime cohort results against final code/candidate, plus broader relevant tests in acceptance-test-inventory.json.

Whole current MediaDive source replay with all legacy/embedded/strict/hydrate fallback routes, occurrence/quantity/native identity preservation and current 632 unknown-association qualification retained. Historical 2026-09 occurrence counts are not current-run pass evidence.
Paired reviewed supported/unified promotion, one real production-path canary, actual invalidated-producer closure rebuild and native/source admission receipts without restamping.
Final clean code gate and exact-head CI, canonical merge/archive, mapping-induced graph comparison, model/path and release validation on new graph generation; old run remains comparison evidence.
review_limits: No source export, test, native gate, producer, or network request was run.
No tracked file or old worktree was changed.
Searches used for inventory included ignored files; no absence claim is based on a default-ignore search.
No current upstream alias suppression or review schema compatibility verdict is made without the exact new archive/export.
